req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-030 requires that (1) every POST /tasks/ response carries a system-assigned integer id, (2) that id is unique across successive calls, and (3) any id supplied by the client in the request body is silently ignored. The test suite covers: EP-positive (valid payload, no client id → server assigns id), NEG (client supplies an explicit id → it is ignored, server id differs), BVA (two back-to-back creates → ids are distinct integers, second id == first+1 under sequential DB autoincrement). Each test asserts exact status code 201, exact field types, and exact uniqueness/override semantics to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_auto_id_assigned_on_valid_create():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {
        "title": "Auto ID Test Task",
        "description": "Checking auto id assignment",
        "completed": False
    }
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["id"] > 20
    assert body["title"] == "Auto ID Test Task"
    assert body["description"] == "Checking auto id assignment"
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_auto_id_assigned_on_valid_create()

preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 20 seed rows
POST /tasks/ and GET /tasks/{task_id} are both reachable
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a new task
Extract the auto-assigned id from the response
Compare the retrieved task with the created task
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with an integer id > 20
GET returns HTTP 200
Retrieved task id matches the auto-assigned id exactly
Retrieved task title matches the submitted title exactly
trace: R-TASK-030: system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task
STC: state transition from created to retrievable via auto-assigned id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_created_task_retrievable_by_auto_id():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "STC Retrieval Task", "completed": False}
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    created = r_create.json()
    auto_id = created["id"]
    assert isinstance(auto_id, int)
    assert auto_id > 20
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{auto_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    retrieved = r_get.json()
    assert retrieved["id"] == auto_id
    assert retrieved["title"] == "STC Retrieval Task"
    assert retrieved["completed"] == False

test_created_task_retrievable_by_auto_id()
